title: Mobile Wells sheet and Android Back navigation
notes: Rebuilt the phone layout after field review to restore a clean map-first interface.
Fixed the Settings gear mounting in the wrong fallback position beside the logo and anchored it to the right side of the header.
Moved Field Mode control into Settings on phones while preserving the persistent Field Mode feature.
Removed the version/data pill and Field Mode button from the phone header to reduce clutter.
Made the universal search card compact and shortened the mobile search copy.
Changed disposal filters from a large vertical dock to one compact horizontal row with visible check and x state indicators.
Reduced the visual size of LSD, well, disposal and cluster markers while retaining their larger interaction hit areas.
Increased low-zoom disposal clustering so the Alberta overview is not covered in individual pins.
Hid the Clear Job map action until an active job exists.
Made the map fill the available phone viewport down to a simpler edge-to-edge bottom navigation bar.
Preserved the Pack 4 accessibility, tablet landscape and desktop three-panel behavior and all Pack 1 through Pack 3 data and offline functionality.
Kept the corrected top-right Settings control at the 44 px minimum field touch target.
Kept normal success text out of the compact phone search card so loading a job cannot make the filter row collide with the search surface.
Field Mode now enlarges the compact phone search controls without returning to the oversized Pack 4 layout.
Raised the mobile search stacking layer so universal-search suggestions always remain tappable above the disposal filter row.
Locked the mobile visual order to search first and disposal filters underneath it with a clear vertical gap.
Universal-search suggestions now suppress disposal controls while open so filters cannot visually cover the search UI or intercept taps.
Rebuilt the phone Surface Wells sheet with a compact 3 by 2 radius grid instead of six oversized full-width buttons.
Compressed the well filter controls and status area so actual surface-well results appear much sooner on screen.
Added in-app mobile sheet history so Android Back or back-swipe closes the open LSD, Wells, Disposals or Saved sheet before normal browser/app navigation.
Switching between mobile sheets replaces the current sheet state instead of stacking duplicate Back presses.
Placed the Wells text filter, Clear and Hide pins controls on one 44 px row to remove the remaining excess toolbar height.
Removed the mobile-only SEARCH AREA label and normal success banner so the first well result appears much higher in the Wells sheet; error messages still remain visible.
